raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Rectangular beam domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 assigns the structural dimensions to Fig. 8(a). The prose gives only a rectangle whose width exceeds its length; numerical extents and aspect ratio are unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Horizontal span W = 2, vertical height H = 1",
        "Horizontal span W = 3, vertical height H = 1",
        "Horizontal span W = 4, vertical height H = 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Force at the top center",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 describes a 'horizontally downward force', combining incompatible directional descriptions.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward force: F = (0, -P)",
        "Horizontal force: F = (P, 0)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Application of the top-center force",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 fixes the load center but does not specify its footprint or how the resultant is assigned to grid nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "Entire resultant P applied to one node at (W/2, H)",
        "Resultant P split equally between the two top-edge nodes bracketing W/2",
        "Uniform traction with resultant P over x/W in [0.49, 0.51] on the top edge",
        "Uniform traction with resultant P over x/W in [0.45, 0.55] on the top edge"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Top-center force resultant",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 4.1 nor Sec. 4.1.1 states the low-fidelity force magnitude.",
      "readings": [
        "P = 1 in consistent force units",
        "P = 10 in the same force units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Mandatory solid or excluded design cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.1.1 do not identify a passive-region mask, including whether material must remain around the supports or load.",
      "readings": [
        "Every element in the rectangle is designable",
        "Fully solid clamp strips occupying x/W in [0, 0.02] and [0.98, 1]",
        "Fully solid loading pad occupying x/W in [0.49, 0.51] and y/H in [0.98, 1]",
        "Both the clamp strips and loading pad are mandatory solid"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Schedule of 160 prescribed volume fractions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 specifies 160 volume-fraction cases between 0.25 and 0.50, but does not specify their spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "V0(i) = 0.25 + 0.25(i/159), i = 0,...,159",
        "V0(i) = 0.25 + 0.25(i/159)^2, i = 0,...,159"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume constraints of the 15 displayed initial designs",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 states that Fig. 8(b) contains five designs per stated L_min value in increasing volume-fraction order, but gives neither their V0 values nor their sample indices.",
      "readings": [
        "For an equally spaced 160-case sweep, select indices {0, 40, 80, 120, 159} for each L_min",
        "For an equally spaced 160-case sweep, select indices {10, 45, 80, 115, 150} for each L_min"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Local material-volume function",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) uses V(mu1, mu2, rho) without defining it. Scaling both bar widths by rho and multiplying the unscaled lattice density by rho give different volume measures.",
      "readings": [
        "Local solid fraction = rho*mu1 + rho*mu2 - rho^2*mu1*mu2",
        "Local solid fraction = rho*(mu1 + mu2 - mu1*mu2)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Volume accounting if passive material is present",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) does not explain whether mandatory solid material, if used, consumes the volume budget or whether the fraction is normalized over the entire rectangle or only designable cells.",
      "readings": [
        "(Designable material volume + passive material volume)/full domain volume <= V0",
        "Designable material volume/designable domain volume <= V0, with passive material outside the budget"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 3.2 specify a two-dimensional elastic model and base-material constants, but do not identify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is reported. With fixed resultant force and normalized volume fraction, a uniform thickness changes the compliance scale.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t = 1",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Numerical homogenized elasticity tensor",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1, Eq. (4), supplies neither the fitted coefficients, polynomial orders, nor the homogenization dataset and its discretization. Eq. (31) requires this orthotropic tensor; replacing it with ordinary isotropic SIMP is not a specified equivalent.",
      "readings": [
        "Periodic cell homogenization on a 100-by-100 cell mesh, a 21-by-21 width-parameter grid, and q_max = r_max = 3",
        "Periodic cell homogenization on a 200-by-200 cell mesh, a 41-by-41 width-parameter grid, and q_max = r_max = 5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Upper bar-width bound L_max",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (33) leaves L_max symbolic. The interpolation domain [0,1]^2 in Sec. 2.1 does not expressly identify whether the optimization uses its full upper extent.",
      "readings": [
        "L_max = 1",
        "L_max = 0.8"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Void stiffness and singularity handling",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Although the nominal rho range is stated, Eqs. (31)–(33) do not specify a residual stiffness or how zero-width, zero-stiffness regions are handled numerically.",
      "readings": [
        "Exactly zero void stiffness, with inactive degrees of freedom removed",
        "Residual isotropic stiffness with E_void/E_solid = 1e-9",
        "Residual isotropic stiffness with E_void/E_solid = 1e-6"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Spatial filter type and filtered fields",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1.1 report no low-fidelity spatial filtering scheme or fields to which it applies.",
      "readings": [
        "No spatial filtering",
        "Conical density filter applied only to rho",
        "Helmholtz filter applied to mu1, mu2, and rho, with theta unfiltered",
        "Conical sensitivity filter applied to the material variables"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Spatial filter radius",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No filter radius is reported. The stated L_min values bound bar variables in Eq. (33); they do not specify a spatial filter radius on the beam grid.",
      "readings": [
        "r = 1.5h, where h is the uniform element width",
        "r = 3h",
        "r = 0.05H"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If filtering is used, the text does not specify its treatment near the rectangular boundary, clamps, or loading point.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the filter neighborhood to the domain and renormalize weights",
        "Pad outside the domain with zero density",
        "Reflect the field across the boundary"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Projection of relaxed material variables",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The low-fidelity implementation does not state whether filtered variables undergo a projection or whether projection sharpness is continued during optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection",
        "Tanh projection of rho with threshold eta = 0.5 and beta = 8",
        "Tanh projection of rho with eta = 0.5 and beta continued through {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Field used to evaluate the volume constraint",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If filtering or projection is introduced, Eq. (33) does not identify whether V is evaluated using raw, filtered, or projected variables.",
      "readings": [
        "Evaluate V using raw optimization variables",
        "Evaluate V using filtered variables",
        "Evaluate V using projected physical variables"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity macro grid resolution and spacing",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No macro-element counts or spacing distribution are reported for Fig. 8. The triangular-mesh discussion in Sec. 2.2.2 concerns high-fidelity geometry evaluation.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform 120-by-40 element grid",
        "Uniform 240-by-80 element grid",
        "Structured 240-by-80 grid with spacing concentrated near the load"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Macro finite-element formulation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text does not specify the low-fidelity element order, interpolation, or integration scheme.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear Q4 displacement elements with 2-by-2 Gauss integration",
        "Q4 elements with reduced integration and hourglass stabilization",
        "Quadratic Q8 elements with 3-by-3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "Exact low-fidelity stiffness objective",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 describes stiffness optimization, but Eqs. (22) and (33) retain an undefined obj. The text does not explicitly identify the Fig. 8 objective as compliance; minimum compliance is an assumption supplied by the requested rerun.",
      "readings": [
        "Minimize compliance F^T U",
        "Minimize the maximum nodal displacement magnitude"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization algorithm and update limits",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1.1 provide the mathematical constraints but not the algorithm or move limits used to solve the low-fidelity problems.",
      "readings": [
        "MMA with maximum changes of 0.1 in mu1, mu2, rho and pi/8 in theta",
        "MMA with maximum changes of 0.2 in mu1, mu2, rho and pi/4 in theta",
        "Sequential quadratic programming with a line search"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial optimization fields and random seed",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 does not give the starting mu1, mu2, theta, and rho fields or state whether random perturbations are used. These can select different local optima.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform mu1 = mu2 = 0.5 and theta = 0, with uniform rho chosen to meet V0",
        "Uniform mu1 = mu2 = 0.5 and theta = pi/4, with uniform rho chosen to meet V0",
        "Perturb uniform material fields by zero-mean values in [-0.01, 0.01], using random seed 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Enforced design symmetry",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 does not report whether the initial-design optimization permits asymmetric material fields or enforces reflection about the beam's vertical centerline.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimize the full rectangle without a symmetry constraint",
        "Enforce reflection symmetry of the physical material distribution about x = W/2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity convergence and iteration limits",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No stopping tolerances or maximum iteration count are given for generating the Fig. 8 designs. The later evolutionary iteration counts do not specify this stage.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop when maximum normalized design-variable change is below 1e-3, with a 200-iteration cap",
        "Stop when relative compliance change is below 1e-6 for ten iterations, with a 1000-iteration cap"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Low-fidelity equilibrium solver accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solution method and residual tolerance for K U = F are not reported for the low-fidelity stage.",
      "readings": [
        "Double-precision sparse direct factorization",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-4"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
